name: multi-role-saas
description: Multi-tenant, multi-role SaaS starter: Next.js App Router + NestJS + Postgres/Prisma + Redis

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run infra:up && npm run install:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
